title: Projects
summary: A Project is a repository, or a folder over several, that worfy shows. You add it once and choose its mode: Full mode keeps the workflow files in the repository, Silent mode in a folder outside it. The Projects list switches the Project a window shows. HANDOFF and the ADRs are read-only views.

scene.description: Projects in worfy. In the window, the Add project dialog adds a Project to the Projects list and, on Connect, has the Harness write its Profile. The Profile names the Workflow folder, which in Full mode is the root of the repository; in Silent mode the Harness keeps the repository free of any trace of the workflow. A click in the Projects list switches the Canvas and opens the Orchestrator of that Project. From the Workflow folder, worfy reads HANDOFF.md for the HANDOFF Node on the Canvas and docs/adr/ for the ADR section of the sidebar.

labels.profileNote: on the Machine, with the mode
labels.step1: Add project: you pick a folder and a mode, a Claude Code Session drafts the Profile, and you review it. Connect has the Harness write the Profile, and the Project joins the list.
labels.step2: The mode decides where the workflow files live. In Full mode the Workflow folder is the repository root. In Silent mode it lies outside, and the Harness refuses commits, branch names and PR texts with a trace of the workflow.
labels.step3: A click in the Projects list switches the Canvas, the Session view and the Pipeline board, and opens that Project's Orchestrator. Every window of the Machine follows.
labels.step4: HANDOFF.md and the ADRs are read from the Workflow folder: HANDOFF as a Node on the Canvas, the ADRs as a sidebar section. An edit to HANDOFF.md is on the Node within a second.

flow.description: The data flow of Projects. In the renderer: the Add project dialog, useProjects and the views of HANDOFF and the ADRs. In the main process: ProjectConnector, ProjectStore, app-orchestrators, LayoutCache and DocsHub. On the side of the Harness: project-connect, bin/profile and the Workflow folder. The dialog calls projects.connect.* on ProjectConnector, which runs project-connect and then adds the folder to ProjectStore. useProjects calls projects.select on ProjectStore, which sends projects.changed back and lets app-orchestrators follow its onChange. LayoutCache asks bin/profile where the files are, and its root goes to DocsHub, which watches the Workflow folder. DocsHub sends docs.changed to the views, and a view reads the text with docs.read.

text: worfy asks the Harness where a Project's files are, and Add project writes only through the Harness script project-connect. The draft Session has only Read, Glob and Grep, and worfy sets the mode and the Workflow folder over its answer.
A list carries a revision, so a late answer does not roll it back. A document's state carries a hash of each file, and a view reads the text again only when the hash changes.

files.src/main/workflow/folder.ts: Asks the Harness where the files are; keeps each answer 30 s
files.src/main/projects/connect.ts: The steps of Add project, and what worfy sets over the draft
files.harness/bin/project-connect: Checks the draft and writes the Profile, with a rollback
files.src/main/projects/store.ts: The list in projects.json, the active Project, the branch
files.src/main/ipc/docs.ts: Picks the documents' root by mode; keeps the HANDOFF Node in step
files.src/main/docs/watch.ts: Reads and watches HANDOFF.md and the ADRs

limits: Connect may take up to 30 minutes, because the write may index the Project for qmd. The facts and the checks have 120 seconds.
A HANDOFF.md or an ADR over 1 MiB is read as absent.
